journal.text: Initial $50,000 account: deploy $41,000, retain $9,000 cash. Price-only trend portfolio using 60 sessions through Sep 30; no fundamental or news assumptions. NVDA broke above its August closing range at 186.58; MU gained about 41% since Aug 29 and recovered toward its September peak, so cap MU at 10%. DASH is near its window closing high. ORLY has a steadier rising trend and recovered to 107.81; 15% provides diversification away from chips. MSFT has recovered from early September weakness. Smaller GOOGL and SHOP positions retain strong multi-month trends but reflect recent pullback volatility. Avoid AMZN, META and GILD for recent weakness; AVGO remains in a sharp pullback. Target weights NVDA/ORLY 15% each, MSFT/DASH 12% each, GOOGL/MU 10% each, SHOP 8%, cash 18%. Review daily but avoid reacting to isolated small moves. Reassess on closes below NVDA 173, MU 154, DASH 253, ORLY 101, MSFT 495, GOOGL 230 or SHOP 139; these are review levels, not guaranteed stops. Weekly compare trend strength and broaden the candidate screen before deploying reserve. Dollar buys avoid unknown-open sizing risk.

Hold all seven positions and $9,000 cash (17.8% of $50,636 equity). Five-session history through Oct 1 confirms all positions remain above review levels. NVDA and MSFT extended gains; GOOGL and SHOP improved. ORLY fell 2.0% and DASH 1.6% close-to-close, but neither warrants reversal after one session. MU rose 8.9% on elevated volume; its weight drifted to 10.9%. Treat 10% as the entry allocation rather than mechanically trim this modest appreciation; no adding after this surge. Reassess MU sizing above 13% equity or a close below 165, raising its prior 154 review level to protect against breakout failure. Other review levels unchanged: NVDA 173, ORLY 101, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230, SHOP 139. Review daily; broaden candidate screen at weekly review before deploying reserve. No new price evidence justifies churn today.

Hold seven positions and $9,003 cash (17.7% of $50,777 equity). Five-session data through Oct 2 show NVDA, MU, GOOGL and SHOP advancing, DASH recovering and MSFT modestly lower. ORLY declined another 0.7%, but remains above its 101 review level; avoid replacing a diversifier based on two weak sessions. MU is 10.9% of equity, below the 13% sizing-review threshold; do not chase its recent surge. No review levels breached, so no trades. Reconsider on closes below NVDA 173, ORLY 101, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230, MU 165 or SHOP 139. These are review triggers, not guaranteed execution prices. Maintain reserve pending broader candidate comparison at next week's review; monitor ORLY weakness and semiconductor concentration.

Weekly review: hold seven positions and $9,003 cash (17.6% of $51,142 equity). Twenty-session comparison through Oct 3 includes eight additional candidates. Existing NVDA, DASH, MSFT and MU trends remain constructive; SHOP broke above September's range on strong volume. GOOGL is consolidating; ORLY remains weak but above September support, with declining volume on its latest retreat. No exit trigger breached. MU is 11.1% of equity; combined NVDA/MU 25.9%, so avoid adding chips. Alternatives do not justify immediate reserve deployment: CEG surged from 329 to 360 in three sessions, AMGN's sharp breakout is only three sessions old, WMT/GILD lack momentum, AVGO remains below September highs, CRWD is consolidating, and PLTR/APP weakened. Watch AMGN for sustained strength above 287 and CEG for a stable consolidation above 347 before further evaluation. Raise SHOP close-based review level from 139 to 145 following breakout; retain NVDA 173, ORLY 101, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230 and MU 165. Review MU sizing above 13% equity. These are reassessment triggers, not guaranteed fills. Retain reserve rather than chase recent jumps; reassess daily and compare candidates again next week.

Hold seven positions and $9,003 cash (17.4% of $51,611 equity). Through Oct 6, MSFT, DASH, GOOGL, MU and SHOP advanced; NVDA pulled back but remains above review support. ORLY fell 1.4% on increased volume and is the weakest holding; monitor closely rather than add. All existing close-based review thresholds remain intact: NVDA 173, ORLY 101, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230, MU 165, SHOP 145. MU is 11.2% of equity and combined NVDA/MU 25.7%; retain winners without adding semiconductor exposure and review MU sizing above 13%. MU and SHOP closed well below intraday highs, cautioning against chasing. AMGN's lower-volume pullback to 294.12 and CEG's wide trading range do not yet establish a compelling new entry; keep watching AMGN above 287 and CEG consolidation above 347. Retain cash reserve. Reconsider on threshold breaches, persistent ORLY deterioration, or a stronger consolidated candidate setup; review levels are not guaranteed fills.

Reduce ORLY by half (34.838373 shares): five consecutive declining closes through Oct 7, now 101.85 versus 105.68 Oct 1, with the last two declines on higher volume than Oct 2-3. Persistent deterioration warrants reducing its roughly 14% equity weight before the 101 review level breaks; retain half near support rather than assume a rebound. Sale should lift cash from 17.7% to about 24.6%, subject to unknown opening fill. Hold remaining positions: Oct 7 pullbacks occurred on lower volume than Oct 6 and all review levels remain intact. No semiconductor additions; NVDA/MU represent 25.7% of equity, MU 11.0%. AMGN rebounded on light volume but lacks convincing follow-through; CEG remains volatile. Do not force replacement purchases. Review remaining ORLY for exit on a close below 101 or continued deterioration; reconsider additions only after stabilization or a stronger candidate setup. Other close-based review levels: NVDA 173, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230, MU 165, SHOP 145; review MU sizing above 13% of equity. Levels are reassessment triggers, not guaranteed fills.

Exit remaining ORLY: Oct 8 close 100.76 broke the 101 review level, extending the persistent decline and finishing near the session low. Reduced volume does not offset continued price deterioration. Selling all 34.838373 shares should raise cash to about $16,059 (31.1% of equity), subject to unknown opening fill. Hold six remaining positions: NVDA, MSFT, DASH, MU and SHOP rebounded; GOOGL slipped on declining volume but remains above support. MU is 11.5% of account value; NVDA/MU together 26.3%, so no chip additions. AMGN declined on higher volume and CEG jumped to 371 rather than offering a quiet consolidation; do not force replacement purchases. Retain close-based review levels NVDA 173, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230, MU 165, SHOP 145; reassess MU sizing above 13% of account value. Review levels are not guaranteed fills. Reconsider cash deployment on a stronger consolidated setup and ORLY only after stabilization and sustained recovery above broken support; compare broader candidates at next weekly review.

Hold six positions and $16,068 cash (31.3% of $51,390 equity). Oct 9 showed mixed action: NVDA advanced on higher volume, while DASH, MU and SHOP pulled back on lower volume. MSFT and especially GOOGL weakened on increased volume; GOOGL has three consecutive declining closes and warrants closer review, but has not broken the 230 risk level. Avoid adding into this weakness. MU is 11.3% of equity; combined NVDA/MU 26.5%, so no additional semiconductor exposure. AMGN's light-volume bounce is inconclusive; CEG advanced to 383.23 and remains too extended for our desired consolidation entry. ORLY continued falling after exit; no reentry. Retain close-based review levels NVDA 173, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230, MU 165, SHOP 145, with earlier reassessment if deterioration persists. Review MU sizing above 13% of equity. These are review triggers, not guaranteed execution prices. Reconsider cash deployment after a stronger consolidated setup; broaden candidate review next week.

Hold six positions and $16,068 cash (32.2% of $49,888 equity). Oct 10 was a synchronized growth-stock selloff: NVDA -4.9%, MU -5.6%, SHOP -7.8%, with higher volume and closes near session lows. MSFT, DASH and GOOGL also weakened; GOOGL now has four declining closes. This is materially worse action, but all established risk-review levels remain intact and the existing cash buffer limits exposure. Do not average down or chase a rebound. Retain review levels NVDA 173, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230 and SHOP 145; raise MU review level from 165 to 179, near Friday's low, to protect part of its remaining gain. Further lower closes accompanied by expanding volume warrant partial reductions even before those levels break, especially GOOGL and SHOP. Levels are decision triggers, not guaranteed fills. Broadened watchlist to AEP, GILD, WMT and CRWD: AEP/GILD/WMT held up on Friday, but prefer confirmation over immediate defensive rotation; CRWD also reversed sharply. AMGN weakened and CEG remains volatile. Reconsider deployment after stabilization and sustained relative strength. NVDA/MU remain 25.9% combined; no semiconductor additions.

Hold six positions and $16,068 cash (31.6% of $50,867 equity). Oct 13 rebounded across all holdings on less volume than Friday's selloff. MU recovered Friday's loss and GOOGL reversed its declining-close streak, while SHOP and MSFT recovered only a small part of their losses. The rebound argues against immediate liquidation but is insufficient confirmation for increased exposure. All existing review levels remain intact: NVDA 173, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230, MU 179, SHOP 145. Reassess weak SHOP/MSFT earlier if they undercut Friday lows (150.60/509.63), particularly on increased volume; review levels are not guaranteed fills. MU is 11.4% of equity and NVDA/MU together 26.4%; avoid semiconductor additions and review MU sizing above 13%. GILD showed constructive resilience at 118.21, but has not cleared the recent 119.33 high; AEP/WMT lack convincing upside follow-through, and CRWD's recovery remains below its recent high. Keep cash available; reconsider deployment after sustained recovery or a consolidated breakout rather than chase one rebound session.

Reduce NVDA by 10 shares after Oct 14's failed rebound: close 180.03 fell below Friday's 182.05 low, near the session low, on volume above Monday's. Trim approximately one quarter rather than exit while the 173 review level remains intact. Expected cash around $17,869 at prior close (actual open unknown), with semiconductor exposure reduced from 25.7% to about 22.1% of equity. Hold remaining positions: GOOGL advanced again; DASH/MU declined on lighter volume. SHOP and MSFT undercut Friday lows intraday but recovered above them, so their closes do not yet confirm breakdowns. SHOP's larger volume and near-test of 145 warrant close monitoring. Retain close-based review levels NVDA 173, MSFT 495, DASH 253, GOOGL 230, MU 179, SHOP 145; continued heavy-volume weakness can prompt earlier reductions. Review MU sizing above 13%. No buys: GILD remains below 119.33, AEP improved but lacks breakout confirmation, CRWD failed its rebound, and WMT's strong high-volume jump to 107.21 merits watching rather than chasing immediately. Reconsider deployment on sustained strength or a controlled consolidation. Review levels are decision triggers, not guaranteed fills.

Hold six positions and $17,916 cash (35.3% of $50,733 equity) after yesterday's NVDA reduction. Oct 15 recovery was selective: GOOGL rose for a third session with increasing volume, MU regained most of Tuesday's loss, and SHOP improved on lighter volume. MSFT was flat and DASH gained but faded intraday. NVDA again surrendered its opening gain, made a lower low and closed slightly lower on increased volume; retain the reduced position rather than add or mechanically trim on every small decline. Semiconductor exposure is now 22.2%, MU 11.4%; no semiconductor additions. Keep close-based review levels NVDA 173, MSFT 495, DASH 253, MU 179, SHOP 145; raise GOOGL's review level to 235, just below Friday's low, after its recovery to 251.03. A decisive NVDA close below 177.29 or renewed heavy-volume weakness warrants earlier reduction. Levels are review triggers, not guaranteed execution prices. No new buys: GILD remains below 119.33, AEP failed to hold its opening breakout, and CRWD remains weak. WMT confirmed strength but is up 6.8% in two sessions; prefer a controlled consolidation rather than chasing. Reconsider cash deployment on sustained recovery with better participation or a watchlist consolidation holding its breakout.

Trim DASH by 6 shares (27% of position) after Oct 16's failed breakout: new recent high 285.50 reversed to 266.67 near the day's low, with volume almost twice Wednesday's and an intraday undercut of Friday's low. The close still holds Friday's close, so reduce rather than exit. Expected cash roughly $19,516 (38.3% of equity) at prior close; opening fill unknown. Hold other positions. NVDA stabilized with a higher low on reduced volume; MSFT remains soft but above 506. MU broke above 201 on strong volume and is 12.0% of equity; let the winner run without adding semiconductor exposure (22.9% combined). Raise MU close-based review level from 179 to 186, near this week's pre-breakout low; review sizing above 13%. Retain NVDA 173 with earlier review below 177.29, MSFT 495 with earlier review below 506, DASH 253 with earlier reduction if weakness confirms below 264.34, GOOGL 235, SHOP 145. These are decision triggers, not guaranteed execution levels. No buys: GILD and AEP failed intraday breakouts; WMT's lower-volume pullback is worth watching but needs stabilization; CRWD made another lower low. Reconsider deployment after stronger closing participation or a controlled watchlist base. GOOGL and SHOP also faded substantial intraday gains, reinforcing patience.

Rotate modestly toward non-tech strength. Sell 5 DASH shares: Friday closed 263.06 below the 264.34 early-review level following the failed breakout, on still-elevated volume. Retain a smaller stake because it recovered from 257.71 and remains above 253; reconsider remainder below 253 or on further failed rebounds. Buy $3,500 GILD starter: 122.81 close cleared both 119.33 resistance and Thursday's 121.57 high on 15.85m volume, more than twice Thursday's. Review below 119 and exit/reduce on a sustained breakout failure below 117; avoid chasing further without consolidation. Buy $3,000 WMT: controlled lower-volume rebound to 107.73, higher low after Thursday's pullback, retaining most of Tuesday's high-volume advance. Review below 105.66, stronger failure below 102.89. These diversify growth-heavy holdings; purchases are limited because GILD is extended and WMT rebound volume is light. Expected cash about $14,315 (28% of equity) at prior prices; fills unknown. Hold NVDA/MSFT/GOOGL/MU/SHOP: Friday closes stabilized or improved, MU held its breakout on reduced volume. MU near 12% of equity, combined semis 22.9%; no additions. Retain review levels NVDA 173 (early 177.29), MSFT 495 (early 506), GOOGL 235, MU 186 with sizing review above 13%, SHOP 145. Levels are close-based decision triggers, not guaranteed fills. Reconsider new exposure if breakouts fail or portfolio weakness broadens.

Hold eight positions and $14,318.81 cash (27.8% of $51,467.12 equity). Monday's recovery supports existing exposure: MSFT and GOOGL advanced, SHOP closed near its high, and DASH stabilized above 264.34 after our trims. NVDA's mild decline came on lower volume and a higher low; WMT also pulled back on reduced volume while holding 105.66. GILD consolidated its breakout with a higher low. No immediate failure warrants selling, and yesterday's diversification purchases deserve time. MU advanced but faded from 214.75 to 206.77; at 12.1% of equity and combined semis 23.0%, do not add. Raise MU early review to 195, the breakout-day low area, retaining 186 as stronger failure and sizing review above 13%. Raise SHOP early review to 154, beneath its recent consolidation, retaining 145 as stronger failure. Other close-based review levels: NVDA 177.29 early/173 stronger, MSFT 506/495, DASH 253 or another failed rebound, GOOGL 247 early/235 stronger, GILD 119/117, WMT 105.66/102.89. These are decision triggers, not guaranteed fills. CRWD reclaimed 500 with improved volume, but prefer confirmation or a controlled retest before adding more growth exposure. AEP remains below recent resistance. Reconsider cash deployment on sustained breakouts or orderly consolidations; reduce exposure if failures broaden.

Hold eight positions and $14,318.81 cash (28.0% of $51,080.10 equity). Tuesday weakened several holdings but did not break close-based review levels. GOOGL is the main concern: fell to 250.46 on 47.31m volume, more than double Monday's, but recovered from 244.15 and closed above 247. Review a close below 247; a break of 244 would strengthen the case for reducing, with 235 the stronger failure level. DASH rejected 267 again and closed 261.97, but volume declined and it remains above Friday's low; after two trims, retain the small 5.8% position rather than repeatedly trim ordinary fluctuations. Reduce on a close below 257.71, with 253 the stronger failure. NVDA and MU pulled back on declining volume; MU remains near its breakout and is 12.0% of equity. No semiconductor additions. MSFT held firm; SHOP retained most of Monday's advance; GILD closed higher, supporting diversification. WMT is approaching 105.66: review on a closing breach, stronger failure 102.89. Other review levels: NVDA 177.29/173, MSFT 506/495, MU 195/186, SHOP 154/145, GILD 119/117. Levels are review triggers, not guaranteed fills. CRWD held above 500 on lighter volume but no need to add growth exposure while GOOGL shows distribution and several holdings soften. AEP remains below resistance. Reconsider cash deployment after sustained strength or controlled retests; reduce if closing failures broaden.

Exit remaining DASH: Wednesday fell 3.7% to 252.31, closing below both 257.71 and stronger 253 review levels, near its 250.38 low, with volume 4.25m versus 2.03m Tuesday. Repeated failed rebounds now culminate in a confirmed closing support break; retain proceeds rather than average down. Expected cash approximately $17,161 (33.8% of equity) at prior close; opening fill unknown. Hold other seven positions. NVDA breached early support intraday but recovered to 180.28; MU similarly recovered from 192.40 to 198.47 above 195. Their higher-volume declines merit scrutiny, not additions. MSFT shows relative strength at 520.54; GOOGL stabilized above 247; SHOP held 159 intraday; WMT bounced at 105.66. GILD pulled back on slightly lighter volume and remains above breakout support. Close-based review levels: NVDA 177.29/173, MU 195/186, MSFT 506/495, GOOGL 247/244 with 235 stronger failure, SHOP 154/145, GILD 119/117, WMT 105.66/102.89. Reduce if closing failures broaden; no new growth exposure while semiconductor weakness persists. Reconsider DASH only after sustained recovery of 258-267 with improved price/volume behavior. Deploy reserves on controlled retests or sustained strength, not merely because cash increased. Review levels are decision triggers, not guaranteed execution prices.

Initiate modest $2,500 CRWD position (~4.9% of equity), leaving $14,645.94 cash (~28.6%). After three closes at/above 500, Thursday broke above the prior 30-bar high of 517.41 to close 521.98 near its high; 3.15m volume exceeded each of the preceding four sessions. This meets the previously watched strength condition, but recent whipsaws and unknown opening gap argue for a starter only. Review a close below 507-510; below 500 would indicate a failed breakout, and below 491.67 strengthens the exit case. Add only after an orderly retest or sustained consolidation, not another vertical jump. Hold seven existing positions: NVDA and MU rebounded, although on less volume than Wednesday's declines; do not add semis (~23% of equity). GOOGL improved and SHOP cleared this week's highs. GILD remains above 119 support on declining pullback volume; WMT continues holding 105.66. Close-based reviews remain NVDA 177.29/173, MU 195/186 (size review above 13% weight), MSFT 506/495, GOOGL 247/244, SHOP 154/145, GILD 119/117, WMT 105.66/102.89. Reduce if failures broaden. Review levels are decision triggers, not guaranteed fills. AEP weakened; no purchase. Retain reserves rather than fully redeploy DASH proceeds.

Hold eight positions and $14,645.94 cash (28.1% of $52,066.87 equity). Friday strengthened growth holdings: MU rose to 219.02 above Monday's 214.75 high on the week's highest volume; SHOP and GOOGL also advanced with increased volume, and NVDA cleared the week's highs. Let winners run rather than sell strength, but no semiconductor additions: MU is 12.7% of equity and combined MU/NVDA 23.6%. Review MU sizing above 13%; a close back below 206-209 would flag breakout failure, below 195 a stronger reduction case. CRWD held Thursday's breakout, with Friday's low 521.87, but faded from 535.52 on lighter volume; keep starter unchanged pending consolidation rather than chase. GILD recovered from an intraday 118.71 breach to 120.94, so its close-based 119 review trigger is not met. WMT remains weak but closed above 105.66 on declining volume; no averaging down. Other close-based reviews: NVDA 177.29/173, MSFT 506/495, GOOGL 247/244, SHOP 159/154, GILD 119/117, WMT 105.66/102.89, CRWD 507-510/500. Reduce on confirmed failures, particularly if weakness broadens. Reconsider deploying reserves after orderly retests or sustained consolidation; one strong day does not justify chasing extended moves. Review levels are decision triggers, not guaranteed fills.

Reduce WMT by half after Monday closed 104.47 below the 105.66 review level, near its 104.15 low. Volume increased to 16.38m from 10.32m, while growth holdings advanced: a meaningful relative-strength and support failure. Retain half pending the stronger 102.89 level; exit remainder on a close below that level or continued failed rebounds. Reconsider recovery only after sustained closes above 105.66-107. No averaging down. Expected cash about $16,099 (30.6% of equity) at prior close; opening proceeds unknown. Hold other seven positions. NVDA, GOOGL and SHOP advanced on rising volume; let winners run without chasing gaps. MU faded its opening gap but held 220.10 and remains 12.6% of equity; combined MU/NVDA 23.8%, so no semiconductor additions. CRWD consolidated above its breakout on lighter volume; keep starter unchanged. GILD remains above 119 despite softness. Close-based review levels: NVDA 183.5/177.29, MU 206-209/195 with sizing review above 13%, MSFT 518/506, GOOGL 255/247, SHOP 168.5/159, GILD 119/117, CRWD 507-510/500. Deploy reserves on orderly retests or sustained consolidation rather than vertical advances; review levels are decision triggers, not guaranteed fills.

Trim GILD by half: Tuesday closed 117.88 below the 119 review level and Friday's 118.71 low, near the session low. Volume was not elevated, so retain half pending the stronger 117 threshold rather than fully exit on the first closing breach. Reduce remainder on a close below 117 or a failed rebound; reconsider strength only after recovery above 119-121. Expected cash approximately $17,776 (33.5% of equity), with actual opening proceeds unknown. Hold other positions. WMT remains weak at 103.17 but above the previously specified 102.89 exit trigger; retain the already halved position without averaging down and exit on a closing breach or continued failed rebound. Growth trends remain strong: NVDA surged on heavy volume, CRWD extended its breakout, and SHOP advanced. Avoid chasing these moves. MU is 12.6% of equity and combined MU/NVDA 24.2%; no semiconductor additions. GOOGL's modest pullback came on lower volume. MSFT retained its gap despite fading intraday. Close-based reviews: NVDA 188.4/183.5, MU 209/195 with sizing review above 13%, MSFT 529/518, GOOGL 255/247, SHOP 168.5/159, CRWD 522/507-510. Hold winners while preserving reserves for orderly retests or sustained consolidation; these levels prompt decisions, not guaranteed execution prices.

Exit remaining WMT: Wednesday close 102.46 breached the previously specified 102.89 exit level after repeated failed rebounds. Falling volume does not negate persistent relative weakness. Reconsider only after sustained recovery above 105.66-107. Expected cash approximately $19,190 (35.9% of equity), actual opening proceeds unknown. Hold seven remaining positions; no need to force reinvestment into extended advances. GILD recovered from 116.70 intraday to 118.50 on increased volume, so the close-based 117 exit condition is not met; retain reduced position, review below 117 or on a failed rebound, require 119-121 recovery before considering additions. Growth holdings remain intact: GOOGL broke higher with increased volume, CRWD consolidated on lighter volume, NVDA extended on heavy volume. MU closed near its daily low but above the prior breakout; weight 12.8%, combined MU/NVDA 24.6%, no semiconductor additions. Review MU sizing above 13%; price reviews 215.7/209. Other close-based review levels: NVDA 191.9/188.4, MSFT 529/518, GOOGL 264/255, SHOP 172.6/168.5, CRWD 533/522. These prompt reassessment, not guaranteed fills. Preserve reserves for orderly retests or sustained consolidation; let winners run while reducing confirmed failures.

Exit remaining GILD after a failed rebound: Thursday reached 120.52 but closed 118.44 below 119, with volume increasing to 8.35m. Although 117 was not breached, the alternative failed-rebound condition is met. Reconsider after sustained recovery above 119-121, not an intraday bounce. Expected cash about $20,877 (39.3% of current equity), actual opening proceeds unknown. Hold six growth positions without additions. MSFT breached the 529 review level on elevated volume but retains the 518-524 pre-gap support area; do not mechanically sell the first retest. Reduce on a close below 518 or another failed rebound below 529-535. NVDA and MU pulled back on lower volume; trends remain intact. MU is 12.7% of equity and combined MU/NVDA 24.4%; no semiconductor additions, review MU sizing above 13%. GOOGL gained but faded a large opening gap on heavy volume; no chasing, watch 280/274 then 264. SHOP held 172.6 narrowly; reduce on confirmed failure of 168.5, reassess below 172.6. CRWD retains 533/522 support. NVDA review 201/191.9 and MU 215.7/209. Maintain reserves pending stable retests rather than buy synchronized growth pullbacks immediately. All review levels use observed closes and do not guarantee execution prices.

Monthly $50,000 deposit lifts equity to $102,970; deploy only a first tranche, not automatic proportional doubling. Trim MSFT by half: Friday closed 517.81 below the 518 review level after failing at 529.32, with volume still elevated. Reassess remainder below 513 or another failed rebound; require recovery of 529-535 before adding. Add $5k GOOGL: held 281 after the large gap on roughly half Thursday's volume; review below 277/274, stronger failure below 264. Add $4k CRWD: higher low and recovery to 543 on moderate volume, retaining 533/522 support; reduce if 522 fails. Initiate $4k ISRG, a small diversifying healthcare position: its large October gap remains intact and Friday rebounded from 526.20 to 534.28 after a lower-volume pullback. This is an early retest, not a confirmed breakout; reassess below 526 and exit on a closing failure of 522, consider adding only after 545-552 recovery. Hold NVDA, MU and SHOP; repeated intraday fades discourage additions. Review NVDA 201/191.9, MU 215.7/209, SHOP 172.6/168.5. Deposit reduces MU/NVDA combined weight to 12.6%; prior concentration concern no longer binds, but price extension remains. Expected cash about $60,861 (59% of equity), opening prices unknown. Stage further deployment only as support holds or fresh bases emerge; AMZN's gap faded and AAPL/AVGO also faded Friday, so avoid chasing. All levels are close-based review signals, not guaranteed fills.

Exit remaining MSFT: Monday's rebound to 524.96 failed below 529-535 and closed 517.03, a third consecutive lower close. This meets the failed-rebound review condition despite lower volume and intact 513 support. Reconsider after sustained recovery above 529-535. Estimated cash after sale $63,886, about 62% of equity; actual opening proceeds unknown. Hold other six positions. Yesterday's GOOGL/CRWD additions and ISRG initiation are progressing: GOOGL held 279.8 and CRWD made a higher low; ISRG recovered to 544.21 but has not cleared 545-552. No immediate additional tranche. NVDA and MU advanced but remain vulnerable to reversal after gaps; avoid chasing. SHOP's rising-volume fade warrants close monitoring, though 172.6/168.5 closing review levels remain intact. Reduce on confirmed 168.5 failure. Other reviews: GOOGL 277/274 then 264; CRWD 533/522; ISRG 526 with exit below 522; NVDA 201/191.9; MU 218.8/215.7. AMZN extended again, while AAPL and AVGO weakened; neither provides an orderly new entry today. Preserve deposit reserves for stable retests or consolidation breakouts, not automatic proportional deployment. Levels are close-based reassessment signals, not guaranteed execution prices.

Exit SHOP fully: Tuesday closed 160.94, decisively below 168.5, after an intraday rebound to 174.13 failed. Volume rose to 16.12m and the close was near the session low; this is more than a marginal support breach. Reconsider only after a stable base or sustained recovery above 168.5-173. Expected cash approximately $68,256 (67% of current equity), with actual opening proceeds unknown. Hold the other five positions without additions during this synchronized growth selloff. NVDA breached the 201 review level but retains 191.9 breakout support; reduce if that fails or rebound repeatedly fails below 201-204. MU reversed sharply to 218.03, below 218.8 but above 215.7; reduce on closing failure of 215.7, with 209 the next support. GOOGL holds 277 narrowly: review below 274, stronger failure below 264. CRWD holds 533 narrowly; reduce below 522 or on a failed rebound with further deterioration. ISRG's lower-volume pullback preserves the retest: review 526, exit below 522, add only after convincing 545-552 recovery. Large cash balance already limits portfolio downside; avoid indiscriminate liquidation of intact trends or immediate dip purchases. Reassess deployment as support stabilizes. All levels are close-based review signals, not guaranteed fills.

Hold all five positions; retain $68,218 cash (66.3% of equity). Wednesday's recovery is uneven, not yet a reason for broad deployment. GOOGL recovered to 284.31 above Tuesday's range; maintain, review below 277/274, stronger failure below 264. MU surged 8.9% to 237.50 on increased volume, preserving its trend but too extended for an immediate addition; review a failed breakout below 224.7, reduce on loss of 215.7. NVDA is the weak link: rebound to 202.92 failed and close fell to 195.21 near the low. Its small 5.8% weight and intact 191.9 support justify one more observation rather than selling into the first failed rebound; reduce on a close below 191.9 or another failed recovery with a lower close. CRWD recovered from 526 to 534.14 on lighter volume; hold, reduce below 522, no additions before recovery of 545-552. ISRG improved to 548.55 on stronger volume, but still beneath repeated 552 resistance; consider a staged addition after a convincing close above 552, review below 535 and exit below 522. AMZN and AAPL show stabilization but not convincing breakout confirmation; keep on watch rather than chase. All thresholds are close-based reviews; opening execution prices are unknown.

Reduce NVDA by half: Thursday closed 188.08, below 191.9 breakout support, after another failed rebound and a third lower close. Volume increased to 223m from 171m. Retain a small residual rather than liquidate everything after the decline; review exit on a close below 183.5 or a failed recovery of 191.9 followed by renewed weakness. Rebuild only after sustained recovery of 195-201. Estimated cash after sale $71,085 (69.3% of current equity), actual opening proceeds unknown. Hold GOOGL, MU, CRWD and ISRG. GOOGL remains resilient at 284.75; review below 277/274, stronger failure below 264. MU held its breakout at 238.33 despite reversing from 246.41; avoid chasing, review below 224.7 and reduce below 215.7. CRWD pierced 522 intraday but recovered to 532.52: closing failure has not occurred; reduce on a close below 522, no add before 545-552 recovery.
